subject: scale vision AI and perception models
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on growing your CV team! Thought I'd reach out since we work with
a lot of robotics teams building similar CV models.

As datasets grow, teams often struggle to keep perception models
accurate-indexing, auto-labeling, and QA can become a bottleneck. Given
your pick & place and object manipulation use cases, I imagine you might be
seeing some of the same hurdles at [COMPANY].

Quick context on Encord: we help perception teams (Pickle Robot, Osaro,
Mytra, Fox Robotics, etc.) automate annotation pipelines across 2D and 3D
data. Many use our model-assisted workflows to scale faster without
compromising accuracy, while keeping full control of their models.

could complement your setup? I can work around your schedule.
